name: Hachimitsu Sou de Hoppe ni Chuu
original_name: はちみつ荘 de ほっぺにチュウ
source:
The hero is a fourth grade student from college who is graduating this year. 

During the summer break from the university, he was living a lazy life and doing nothing all the time. Onde day, his parents kicked him out of home. Seeking independence, tries to find a part-time job. And then he becomes an apartment manager. In his the last summer vacation, his stopped time begins to move. 

[Shortly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=22688]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名即将于今年毕业的大学四年级学生。

大学暑假期间，他每天懒散度日，无所事事。一天，父母把他赶出家门。为了实现独立，他开始寻找兼职，最终成为一名公寓管理员。在大学最后一个暑假里，他停滞已久的时间重新开始流动。

[简译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=22688]Getchu.com[/url]]
